scope: One real-photo runtime/ordinal smoke check, not a held-out product quality evaluation

photo.author: Lo / L's pets & stuff
photo.normalization: EXIF transpose, RGB, Pillow LANCZOS longest edge1280 without upscaling; differs from product browser normalization

annotation: Original visual near/far judgments by the implementer before viewing any model output; no measured metric ground truth. Coordinates are normalized image coordinates. Median of3×3 predicted-depth neighborhood. Larger raw inverse depth predicts nearer; ties count as incorrect. No thresholds or model tuning after freezing.
baseline: Current unpainted Lens study assigns every pixel to subject; all5 ordinal comparisons tie, so0/5 strict correct. Manually authored masks are not evaluated here.
